inputs.text:
The Punjab and Haryana High Court has granted regular bail to a man booked under national-security provisions and the Official Secrets Act, saying mere suspicion of sharing sensitive information with someone in Pakistan cannot justify prolonged incarceration. He was allegedly in telephone contact with Karachi-based “Punjabi Kuri.”

Bail is not a finding of innocence. Contacts involving sensitive information and Pakistan deserve serious scrutiny; the state must protect national security and ensure its case is properly supported. But detention cannot rest on suspicion alone.
